( n. ) disgust; recoiling from ; Th 1056 (bhuñjamāne ca bhutte vā ~aṃ me na vijjati); Sv 359, 21 (jigucchāya bhāvo ~aṃ); — °- tama , mfn., superl. , very disgusting ; Ud-a 289, 1 (asuci duggandho ~o); — °- tara , mfn., compar. , more disgusting ; Vism 249, 32 (tato ~o aggimhi pakkhittānaṃ [kesānaṃ gandho]); — °- bībhacchadassana , mfn. , detestable and fearful-looking ; Pv-a 56, 3 (~ā, Be, Ce so; Ee jiguccha-; Se jegucchavibhacchadassanā); — ajeguccha , mfn. , not to be despised; not being disgusting ; M I 31, 17 (appaṭikulyatā ca saṇṭhaheyya ~-tā ca saṇṭhaheyya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ajegucchitā); Sn 852 (appagabbho ~o; Pj II 549, 23 : ~o ti sampannasīlāditāya ajegucchanīyo asecanako manāpo); Th 961 (~aṃ vimuttehi … kāsāvaṃ; Th-a III 86, 32 : ~an ti ajigucchitabbaṃ); Nidd I 231, 32 (katamo ca puggalo ~o); — atijeguccha , mfn. , very disgusting ; Spk I 151, 7 (tesaṃ ca moramaṃsādīni iṭṭhāni honti, itaresaṃ tāni ~āni); Vibh-a 233, 7 ; — see also adhijeguccha, adhijegucchaṃ, adhijegucche, jiguccha.
